name: How long does historic millwork restoration take?

mainEntity.name: How long does historic millwork restoration take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of historic millwork restoration varies widely based on the scope, condition, and complexity of the project. A small trim repair might take a few days, while a full house of intricate window and door restoration could span several weeks or even months. The process timing can also be affected by the need to source specific, period-accurate materials or allow for adequate curing times for specialized finishes. We provide an estimated timeline after a thorough on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Historic millwork restoration timing depends on project scope, condition, and complexity, ranging from days for minor repairs to months for larger projects.
